dimensions.assessment: Directs an official study by the Secretary of Agriculture regarding a trail located between the Idaho-Utah border and Nephi, Utah.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Secretary of Agriculture to conduct a study on the feasibility of designating the Bonneville Shoreline Trail

dimensions.assessment: Performs a feasibility study without altering land status, regulations, or private property rights directly.
Involves administrative costs for conducting a federal study, but no specific monetary appropriations or economic figures are cited.
Amends Section 5(c) of the National Trails System Act by adding a single study item.

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a one-time study rather than ongoing permanent operational changes.

missing_information: The cost of conducting the feasibility study is not specified.
The exact timeline for completing the study is not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs a federal feasibility study regarding the potential designation of a trail system, representing a localized administrative action with no immediate regulatory or economic changes.
